card0.heading: Dark red Vans
card0.body: A timeless low-top skate shoe in dark red canvas with clean lines and everyday versatility.
card0.alt: A dark red Vans low-top sneaker photographed against a warm yellow background.

card1.heading: Orange Adidas
card1.body: A bright orange running shoe built to stand out, with high-visibility color and lightweight athletic styling.
card1.alt: A single orange Adidas running shoe photographed on a textured dark stone surface.

card2.heading: White Pumas
card2.body: A clean white classic with old-school streetwear roots and just enough history to back it up.
card2.alt: A white Puma sneaker photographed outdoors with a soft city skyline in the background.

card3.heading: And1 Hightops
card3.body: A gray high-top basketball sneaker with textured panels and a bold, street-ready silhouette.
card3.alt: A pair of gray And1 high-top basketball sneakers photographed against a clean white background.

card4.heading: Uh oh, someone tossed your sneak!
card4.body: Not exactly performance gear, but definitely a cautionary tale. Keep an eye on your sneakers around this guy.
card4.alt: A hand tossing a sneaker into the air against a bright outdoor sky.

card5.heading: Converse All-Stars
card5.body: An iconic high-top with timeless style, canvas construction, and enough attitude to outlast the trends.
card5.alt: An orange Converse All-Star high-top sneaker held up against a softly blurred outdoor background.

card6.heading: Nike Dunk low
card6.body: A dependable everyday sneaker with clean color blocking, solid comfort, and easy all-around wearability.
card6.alt: A black and white Nike Dunk Low sneaker photographed against a white background.

card7.heading: White Nike Air
card7.body: A crisp white court sneaker with enough support and grip for casual play and everyday movement.
card7.alt: A white Nike Air low-top sneaker hovering above a blue court surface.

card8.heading: Neon Green Nikes
card8.body: A bright neon running shoe designed for visibility, comfort, and staying seen on early or late runs.
card8.alt: A neon green Nike running shoe photographed against a matching green background.

card9.heading: Red Nike minimal running shoe
card9.body: A lightweight red running shoe with a stripped-back profile made for speed, flexibility, and ground feel.
card9.alt: A red Nike minimal running shoe photographed against a matching red background.

card10.heading: Puma Skate Shoes
card10.body: A low-profile skate shoe with understated styling, neutral tones, and enough versatility to wear with just about anything.
card10.alt: A gray, black, and white Puma low-top skate shoe photographed against a white background.
